through_line: The design idea of a reliable, simple, and rugged assault rifle that survived every revision

stages.title: Initial Design Concept
stages.summary: Mikhail Kalashnikov began designing an assault rifle in response to the Soviet need for a reliable and simple weapon. The design was influenced by previous advancements and the need for a rifle that could fire the 7.62-mm intermediate cartridge.
stages.driver: Soviet search for a reliable and simple assault rifle
stages.impact: Led to the development of a new infantry rifle

changes.detail: allowed for a more reliable and simple design

stages.title: First Prototype
stages.summary: The first prototype of the AK-47 was designed and tested, featuring a short-stroke gas piston and a rotary bolt. The design was refined and improved based on feedback from trials.
stages.driver: Need for a reliable and accurate rifle
stages.impact: Led to the adoption of the AK-47 by the Soviet military

stages.title: Field Trials and Adoption
stages.summary: The AK-47 underwent field trials and was adopted by the Soviet military as their standard issue assault rifle. The design was proven to be reliable and rugged, with a high volume of fire and reasonable accuracy.
stages.driver: Soviet military's need for a reliable and simple rifle
stages.impact: Led to the widespread adoption of the AK-47

changes.detail: changed from milled to stamped steel

stages.title: Modernization and Simplification
stages.summary: The AKM was introduced, featuring a stamped steel receiver and other simplifications to reduce production costs and weight. The design was further refined and improved based on feedback from users.
stages.driver: Need to reduce production costs and weight
stages.impact: Led to the widespread adoption of the AKM

changes.detail: changed from milled to stamped steel

stages.title: Introduction of the AK-74
stages.summary: The AK-74 was introduced, featuring a new cartridge (5.45x39mm) and other improvements to the design. The AK-74 was designed to be more accurate and reliable than the AK-47.
stages.driver: Need for a more accurate and reliable rifle
stages.impact: Led to the adoption of the AK-74 by the Soviet military

changes.detail: adjusted to correspond with altered pressure dynamics

stages.title: Introduction of the AK-12
stages.summary: The AK-12 was introduced, featuring a modernized design with a folding stock, rails for accessories, and other improvements. The AK-12 was designed to be more ergonomic and adaptable to modern warfare.
stages.driver: Need for a more modern and adaptable rifle
stages.impact: Led to the adoption of the AK-12 by the Russian military

stages.title: Current Production and Use
stages.summary: The AK-12 is currently in production and use by the Russian military and other countries. The design continues to evolve with new improvements and variants being developed.
stages.driver: Ongoing need for a reliable and adaptable rifle
stages.impact: Continued use and adoption of the AK-12

changes.detail: use of modern manufacturing processes and materials
